chapter: Childhood, drums and early church bands
title: Joining the St. Agnes Cornet Band under Bella Roberts
summary: Bella Roberts, leader of the St. Agnes band, asked his mother if the eleven-year-old could play drums with the marching band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah. See, while I was playing with the UNIA band, most of the large churches had their own marching bands, like St. Agnes Church, which was one of the biggest Episcopal churches in Miami for black people, they had their own band -- the St. Agnes Cornet Band, and the guy that was the leader of that band was a guy from Nassau by the name of Roberts, but everybody called him Bella Roberts -- he was a great trumpet player.
And one day he came by the house, and asked my mother if I could join the St. Agnes Band as a drummer, so here I was, 11 years old, playing in the St. Agnes Marching Band.
